title: 毎日杯の後に・行雲流水

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki has won the Mainichi Hai!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she raced, she became aware of the stark contrast between her own running style and Oguri Cap's relaxed gait.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a great performance under her belt, Yaeno Muteki sets her sights on the Satsuki Sho. The start of the Classic Triple Crown tour is within sight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her classmate and rival Mejiro Ardan has to sit out the Satsuki Sho. It seems like her legs are in poor condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While it's an unfortunate turn of events, it doesn't change Yaeno Muteki's ambition. She declares Sakura Chiyono O her rival and vows to defeat her.
